name: fastmcp-canonical
instr:
The repository at `/workdir` is FastMCP, a Python framework for building Model Context Protocol (MCP)
servers and clients. A server registers tools, resources, resource templates and prompts, usually from
decorated Python functions whose signatures and docstrings become their schemas; runs requests through
middleware; combines components from providers and mounted servers; reshapes them with transforms such as
namespacing, visibility rules, version filtering and tool transformation; and serves them to MCP clients,
including the in-memory `Client(server)` connection used for testing.

Fix all implementation drift from the documentation in this repository.
Everything in scope is the FastMCP server framework under fastmcp_slim/fastmcp/: the server package (server/__init__.py, server.py, context.py, dependencies.py, lifespan.py, completions.py and caching.py, the middleware/ package except authorization.py, the mixins/ package except transport.py, the providers/ package except proxy.py, the prefab modules and the openapi/ and skills/ subpackages, and the whole transforms/ package), the tools/, resources/ and prompts/ packages, exceptions.py, settings.py and utilities/{components,json_schema,mime,pagination,timeout,types,versions}.py, together with README.md, docs/more/settings.mdx, docs/servers/{server,tools,resources,prompts,context,middleware,composition,pagination,versioning,visibility,lifespan,dependency-injection,logging,progress,completions,icons}.mdx, docs/servers/provider
